# FoliageMesh

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("FoliageMesh")`

One mesh a `FoliageLayer` grows (ADR 0116), with its share of the layer, its size, how it sits on the ground and how the wind moves it.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AlignToNormal` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How much it leans with the ground, from 0 upright to 1 along the slope. |
| `CastShadow` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether it casts a shadow, near the camera: `[render] foliage_shadow_distance` is how near. |
| `Material` | `Material?` | — | read/write | What it is drawn with: a material asset, or nothing for the mesh's own. A material whose surface shader has a `surfaceVertex` moves it as it likes, with the wind and the instance's random value; otherwise the built-in sway bends it from its base. |
| `Mesh` | `Content` | `""` | read/write | The mesh that grows: any mesh asset of the project. |
| `RandomRotation` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether each instance turns about its up axis at random, so a field is not rows of the same leaf. |
| `ScaleMax` | `number` | `1.2` | read/write | The largest an instance is, as a multiple of the mesh. |
| `ScaleMin` | `number` | `0.8` | read/write | The smallest an instance is, as a multiple of the mesh. |
| `Sink` | `number` | `0.05` | read/write | How far below the ground its base goes, in metres, so a stem on a slope is not floating at one edge. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How hard it resists the wind: a reed 0.5, a bush 3. |
| `Weight` | `number` | `1` | read/write | Its share of the layer's instances against the other meshes of the layer: two meshes of weight 1 and 3 grow one to three. |
| `WindResponse` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much the wind moves it, from 0 still to 1 full sway. |
